scalars.scalar_value: One (1) year of Operating Room Technician experience in an acute care setting or graduation from an accredited surgical technology program with externship at Mercy San Juan Main OR.

items.item_text: One (1) year of Operating Room Technician experience in an acute care setting or graduation from an accredited surgical technology program with externship at Mercy San Juan Main OR.
(When the unit is staffed with enough experienced surgical techs to support a recent graduate of a surgical tech program or internship, applicants without the requisite experience may be considered).
Technical Skills: Competent in psychomotor skills and technical procedures.
Responsible and accountable for using aseptic technique principles in preparation for and assisting with surgical procedures and to create and maintain a sterile field.
Sets up and is prepared sufficiently ahead of time to prevent delays in the schedule and to facilitate case flow.
Utilizes physician's preference cards/receipts to obtain instruments, supplies, and equipment in preparation for each case.
Maintains adequate supplies during procedure, anticipates needs and is an active participant in surgical procedures.
Responsible and accountable for sharps containment, safety and disposal to facilitate safe handling by assistants.
Basic Life Support from the American Heart Association.
